level: >= 25% of book equity from the high-water mark
observable_from: /blend/feed equity_curve (X-Read-Token; one point per cycle-day; HWM and DD computed by hand from it — the executor tracks no HWM). NOT /status (intraday marks only, no history); a cycle-day point can be marked at the STOP level for an unquoted held name (_mark_price), bounded by open risk (<= ~3% of book): confirm a borderline reading against the next day
basis: executor-fidelity replay of the live 30/70 rules: realized max DD 28.3% (2020-02-20 -> 2020-03-23, SPY-led), bootstrap p5/p50/p95 14.6/26.3/40.1%; the sleeve-led 2022 bear reached 20.4% on the book
action_as_coded: none on the book; a written review within 5 sessions (fills vs entry_ref, missed entries, stop placement, unreconciled, regime) logged in this ledger
review_rule: re-derive from the then-current mirror results JSON; re-arm or re-level; 'resolved' = fired (date in notes) or superseded
notes: Written 38 days AFTER go-live (money moved 2026-08-28), against the IC rule that tripwires precede money; recorded as such. Measured-curve caveat: book_value credits no SPY dividends or BIL distributions (cash reconcile is alert-only), ~2 pp/yr of drag vs the total-return replay, so live drawdowns read deeper and underwater clocks longer than the replay basis. PENDING (due at the first R1 monthly review or when the feed is pasted, whichever first): hwm_at_write, hwm_date and the equity_curve's FIRST date — that read also verifies 'no re-seed since 2026-08-28'. 2026-10-05 (same day, later): a deposit is being adopted into the book through stage-2 cash adoption (POST /blend/cash/adopt); the feed now carries book.capital_contributed and capital_events (seed + adopted deposits with dates and amounts). Compute the HWM and the drawdown on the FLOW-ADJUSTED series by CHAIN-LINKING: on each capital_events date take the day's return as (E_d - usd_d)/E_{d-1} - 1, cumulate into an index, read HWM/DD off the index. Do NOT subtract the deposits from the points: that dollar series overstates the % drawdown after a deposit (seed 50k, HWM 52k, adopt 70k, fall to 100k: chain-linked 18.0%, subtracted 42.3%, a false crossing of both review lines; counter-agent A4). The raw curve steps up by the deposit and would mask a drawdown in progress.

action_as_coded: review the CORE weight decision (the 30/70 construction), not the sleeve; explicitly NOT a sleeve flatten — selling the sleeve into an index trough is the harm a halt rule causes; nothing automatic
source: same JSON; exceedance recomputed from the committed cache with the mirror's bootstrap construction (seed 20261001, 2,000 draws): P(>=25%) 0.54, P(>=30%) 0.30, P(>=35%) 0.124, P(>=40%) 0.051
notes: A halt rule was never replayed. On the live-rules curves the 25% line is first crossed 2020-03-20 (book; trough 03-23) and 2020-03-09 / 2023-02-21 (sleeve alone; troughs 04-09 / 03-10): near the trough, not at it.

level: >= 45% of sleeve equity from its high-water mark on a TRANSFER-ADJUSTED basis
observable_from: NOT OBSERVABLE YET: the executor exposes no transfer-adjusted sleeve curve and no HWM (sleeve_value moves with REBALANCE transfers). Instrument = next build: executor-side sleeve HWM on a transfer-adjusted basis + an ALERT-ONLY tripwire; until then this line is written, not armed. 2026-10-05 (later): the executor now records capital flows (capital_events: seed, deposit_adopted with the sleeve/core split) - the flow half of the transfer adjustment exists; the sleeve HWM instrument itself is still pending
basis: sleeve-only live-rules replay (exec_t2_carry): realized max DD 29.4% (peak 2018-09-18 -> trough 2020-04-09; the 25% line was first crossed 2020-03-09), bootstrap p5/p50/p95 22.6/33.4/52.2%, longest underwater 1,269 d (2021-01-19 -> 2024-07-11); P(>=45%) = 0.13, P(>=50%) = 0.067 (lower bounds). 45% sits above the realized and the median and inside the p5-p95 cone: a breach says this is not the engine that was replayed, at a ~13%-per-decade false-kill rate
action_as_coded: /kill as coded: cancels the sleeve's stops and MKT-sells st.positions only (SPY and BIL untouched); proceeds land in sleeve CASH and are swept to BIL only after /resume (step() returns nothing while halted); /kill also halts the parked ladder. /resume clears EVERY halt with no review gate: the written review is a human rule, nothing enforces it. /kill's flatten path has NEVER run against IBKR (README, Operating rules): the first live /kill is its own test; watch /status flatten_pending and the parked rows
review_rule: the instrument build (executor-side transfer-adjusted sleeve HWM + alert-only tripwire) is due by the first R1 monthly review (2026-11-05); an unarmed kill line does not sit indefinitely. Arm the LEVEL then, from the live transfer-adjusted series, not from this replay: the live sleeve is ~$15k, where 1%-risk sizing meets whole-share rounding and zero-qty skips far more often than the $100k replay (skipped_zero_qty = 2 there). 45% is a ~13%-per-decade false-fire rate (lower bound); p95 (52%) would be ~5% — Casey's call at arming
source: same JSON variants.exec_t2_carry.windows.full + .bootstrap.full; exceedance recomputed as above
notes: Sleeve-in-blend curve with flows included reached 28.1% in the replay; that series is not the right basis (transfers move it), hence transfer-adjusted. Rebalance transfers (REBALANCE intents) and stage-2 adoptions (capital_events.sleeve_usd) are the two flows to remove from sleeve_value before the HWM.

level: >= 30 calendar months below the high-water mark
observable_from: same as line 1 (HWM date from the feed curve)
basis: replay longest underwater for the live 30/70 rules: 715 d (~23.5 months, 2022-01-03 -> 2023-12-19); the sleeve alone 1,269 d (~42 months). A single realized number, no duration distribution (the bootstrap destroys persistence): 30 months = 1.28x the book's worst, a review line only
action_as_coded: written review; the sleeve weight (BLEND_SLEEVE_TARGET) is the only lever and only via a new pre-registered study; nothing automatic
notes: Dividend/BIL-distribution drag (~2 pp/yr, unmeasured by the ledger curve) lengthens the measured clock by ~5% of equity over 30 months; read the clock with that in mind or build stage-2 cash adoption first. Same flow adjustment as line 1 applies to the HWM date: a deposit is not a new high.
